sources: Microsoft Learn: 'SystemParametersInfoW function', SPI_SETMOUSESPEED: 1 (slowest) to 20 (fastest), 10 is the default. The app restores the previous value when resetting.
The description promises no FPS effect: games that read the mouse directly (raw input) ignore this setting.
measuredOn: Microsoft Learn: SystemParametersInfo SPI_SETMOUSESPEED (10 = Windows default, pointer speed slider in the middle); changes something only if the speed was moved away from the middle
